scope: Project configuration read/revision coherence, stale save conflicts, external rule preservation and fresh-read/save recovery

before.reproduction: Ran all 5 new cases against the unchanged release service. Four failures reproduced mixed revisions and wrongly accepted stale saves; one existing-behavior case passed.

skipReason: Node/Rust archive interoperability requires VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; native archive code unchanged
testEnvironment: Temporary registered workspaces run actual configuration reads and saves. Isolated child processes atomically replace the manifest immediately after its first read returns, without timers. Generated and file-backed templates both reject stale saves before template writes, preserve the external manifest bytes, and save correctly after a fresh read. Original document bytes and registry records stay identical. Label-only edits retain template source bytes and explicit parser rules. Existing engine/template/dialog tests also ran; no native window interaction.
